parent_adjustments.reason: The decoded wide final frame showed the save CTA overlapping the small Studio Yebisu footer. Raised only the landscape CTA center by30px, keeping diagram, timings, portrait layout and frozen inputs/audio unchanged.

parent_adjustments.file: index.html, comparison.html, documentation and production metadata
parent_adjustments.reason: Keep original runtime/data viewer behavior intact while updating its film links and qualifying the statement that the entire original comparison page was unchanged. Record completed render/QA separately from listening and human approval.

video_review.reviewer: Production agent inspection of genuine rendered/decoded frames; not human approval.

portrait.reason: Only landscape CTA moves30px up to avoid footer overlap; portrait including actual MP4 stays byte-identical.

wide.reason: Only landscape CTA moves30px up to avoid footer overlap; portrait including actual MP4 stays byte-identical.

findings: The large connected root-guide / child-guide / two-detail diagram and the stage-tray / inspection-gate / Git dots remain visible from the first frame. No text-card, JSON or log slideshow.
Removing the child guide visibly breaks both links and blocks the gate; two staged changes remain and no new solid Git dot appears. The hollow dashed position is a conceptual empty saved slot.

The restored-guide case is explicitly a separate L03 recorded trial, then the film explicitly returns to L02. Moving between diagrams does not represent executing a Git rollback or editing live memory.

The actual guide-card transfer is visible over12 consecutive frames. Main Japanese labels and full relationship are readable in decoded360px portrait frames; large shapes dominate both native layouts.

The final diagram holds through frame959 and distinguishes shape inspection from content correctness. A30px upward shift of the wide save cue removed its overlap with the footer; the final revised frame was inspected.
Five actual Irodori TTS cues are sample-exact in the source timeline and correspond to the same scene timestamps. MP4 audio is normalized/AAC encoded. Listening remains unconfirmed.

publication.authorization: User requested existing text-heavy examples revised with animated concept diagrams and actual Japanese TTS, sequentially published to existing main/Pages.
